name: guardian-angel
description: A conscience for Claude Code: every tool call is judged by a local reflex, and what the reflex cannot settle goes to the Guardian Angel service (System 1 intuition, System 2 deliberation) and, when needed, to you.

link_token.title: Link token
link_token.description: From the Set up page at https://ga.linbeck.app/setup (single use, valid ten minutes). Links this machine to your Guardian Angel account at the start of the next session. Leave blank if this machine is already linked.

service_url.title: Service URL
service_url.description: The Guardian Angel service this machine reports to.
